SQLITE_ERROR_no_such_table.solution: 💡 Database not initialized. Run 'ultra-dex init' to set up.

SQLITE_BUSY_database_locked.solution: 🔒 Another process is using the database. Wait a moment and try again.

SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_violation.solution: 🚫 Invalid data provided. Check your input format and try again.

ECONNREFUSED.solution: 🌐 Service is not responding. Check if the required service is running.

ENOTFOUND.solution: 🌐 DNS lookup failed. Check your internet connection and host configuration.

ETIMEDOUT.solution: ⏰ Request took too long. Check your network connection and try again.

ENOENT.solution: 📁 Path does not exist. Verify the file path is correct.

EACCES.solution: 🔐 Insufficient permissions. Run with appropriate privileges or check file permissions.

EPERM.solution: 🔐 Permission error. Check file/directory permissions and ownership.

401_unauthorized.solution: 🔑 Invalid API key. Check your provider configuration with `ultra-dex config --wizard`.

403_forbidden.solution: 🔐 Access denied by provider. Verify your API key and permissions.

429_rate_limit.solution: ⏱️ Too many requests. Wait before trying again or upgrade your provider plan.

500_internal_error.solution: 🔧 Provider server error. Try again later or contact provider support.

MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.solution: 💾 Too much data processed at once. Try breaking your task into smaller chunks.

CONFIG_NOT_FOUND.solution: ⚙️ Configuration file missing. Run 'ultra-dex init' to create default configuration.

AGENT_UNAVAILABLE.solution: 🤖 Requested agent is not available. Check agent status or try a different agent.

UNKNOWN_ERROR.solution: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Check the logs for details and try again.

init_EACCES.solution: 🔐 Permission denied when creating .ultra-dex directory. Check parent directory permissions.

memory_SQLITE_ERROR.solution: 🧠 Memory system failed to initialize. Run `ultra-dex init` to reset memory system.

provider_MISSING_API_KEY.solution: 🔑 No API key found for provider. Run `ultra-dex config --wizard` to set up providers.
